function: Self-supervised CNN refinement of the LS pre-estimate for massive MIMO channel estimation, trained zero-shot from one noisy observation, with Meta-SGD online adaptation (p. 4; p. 6).
system: Narrowband single-user TDD massive MIMO, 64 BS receive and 32 UE transmit antennas, orthogonal pilots of length 36; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3; p. 9).
method: Four-layer CNN trained self-supervised on pseudo-pairs from a non-local channel-coefficient bank with a cross-reconstruction plus sampling-consistency loss; Meta-SGD meta-learning for few-step online adaptation (p. 6; p. 7).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa 3GPP 38.901 UMi LoS (default) and NLoS channels; Gaussian, Laplacian, BGIN, alpha-stable and colored noise; DnCNN baseline: 32000 training, 4000 test, 4000 validation samples (p. 9; p. 12).
test_conditions: Online adaptation from a meta-initialization trained on LS outputs of varied SNRs, antennas, Doppler, LoS/NLoS; tests sweep SNR, noise type, NLoS, antennas, pilots (p. 7; p. 10).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, LMMSE. Learned: DnCNN [24] (supervised), DIP [14] and Self2Self [26] (self-supervised); ablations without Meta-SGD or non-local bank (p. 9; p. 14).
metrics: NMSE (dB) versus SNR, noise type, antennas, pilots, epochs; downlink spectral efficiency with ZF precoding; run time, parameters, FLOPs, memory (p. 9; p. 12).
complexity: 224.5 k parameters, 229 M FLOPs, 131 MB memory; GPU 2.82 s and CPU 3.34 s run time, 1.48% and 0.26% of Self2Self (p. 11; p. 12).
q1_support: p. 9: "3GPP 38.901 Urban Micro (UMi) LoS model"; the text says all channels come from the 3GPP model within the "QuaDRiGa simulation framework [53]".
q2_support: p. 7: "different SNRs, antenna configurations, Doppler spreads and" LoS/NLoS conditions form the meta-training pool, and each test channel is adapted on its own LS output; the paper never states which test condition (Figs. 7-10, Tables II-III) was held out of meta-training.
q3_support: p. 9: "For traditional benchmarks, we employ the traditional LS" and LMMSE; p. 9: "we select DIP [14] and the recently" proposed Self2Self [26], plus DnCNN [24]; all compared on NMSE in Figs. 3-10 (p. 10-11).
q4_support: p. 11: "Each forward pass requires just 230 M FLOPs"; Table I (p. 12) lists 224.51 k parameters, 229.11 M FLOPs, 131.40 MB and GPU/CPU run times of 2.82 s and 3.34 s.
q5_support: p. 9: "QuaDRiGa simulation framework [53]", executed in MATLAB: channels are generated with an open simulator, but the paper gives no code or data link, DOI or availability statement, and uses no public dataset.
notes: Area 2: channel estimation (self-supervised denoising of the LS estimate). q2 is borderline: Meta-SGD adapts the model to each new channel (p. 4; p. 7), but no held-out meta-training condition is stated, so 0; reviewer to confirm. q5 is 0 because QuaDRiGa is a simulator, not a released dataset. Tables I-VI and Figs. 3-18 were read from page images (p. 10-14). An earlier conference version is ref. [1] (p. 1).
